2607.23970.title: Understanding Machine Unlearning Through the Lens of Mode Connectivity
2607.23970.paper_summary: Machine Unlearning aims to remove undesired information from trained models without full retraining from scratch. Despite recent progress, the loss landscape and optimization geometry of unlearning are poorly understood. In this paper, we study machine unlearning through the lens of mode connectivity--the phenomenon that independently trained models can often be connected by smooth low-loss paths in parameter space. We introduce {\em mode connectivity in unlearning} (MCU) and evaluate it across a range of settings, including curriculum learning, second-order optimization, and connectivity across different unlearning methods. We find that many unlearned models lie in connected basins with smooth retain/forget behavior, while changes in training dynamics can move solutions into different basins. MCU also reveals that models within the same basin can differ substantially on privacy metrics, and that unlearning progresses nonlinearly from the original model to the unlearned model. In addition, linear connectivity suggests that most approximate unlearning methods are mechanistically distinct from retraining. Finally, MCU-based ensembling can improve generalization and robustness to relearning attacks, and MCU smoothness correlates with unlearning difficulty. To our knowledge, this is the first study of machine unlearning through the lens of mode connectivity.
2607.23970.paper_summary_zh: 機器遺忘旨在從訓練過的模型中移除不需要的信息，而無需從頭開始完全重新訓練。儘管最近取得了一些進展，但遺忘的損失景觀和優化幾何仍然不甚了解。本文通過模式連通性的視角研究機器遺忘——這是一種現象，獨立訓練的模型通常可以在參數空間中通過平滑的低損失路徑連接起來。我們引入了{\em 遺忘中的模式連通性}（MCU），並在包括課程學習、二階優化和不同遺忘方法之間的連通性等多種設置中進行評估。我們發現，許多被遺忘的模型位於連通的盆地中，具有平滑的保留/遺忘行為，而訓練動態的變化可以將解移動到不同的盆地中。MCU還揭示了同一盆地中的模型在隱私指標上可以有顯著的差異，並且遺忘的過程是從原始模型到被遺忘模型的非線性進展。此外，線性連通性表明，大多數近似遺忘方法在機制上與重新訓練是不同的。最後，基於MCU的集成可以改善對重新學習攻擊的泛化能力和穩健性，並且MCU的平滑性與遺忘的難度相關。據我們所知，這是第一個通過模式連通性視角研究機器遺忘的研究。
